column1: # The overlap fixture of S1.6 (plan 2, fix round C, C1-7): fixtures/overlap, a parent folder that holds a photos/ subfolder and two
# loose photos, so that picking the parent AND photos/ makes one folder lie inside the other and every file under photos/ is
# reachable through both picks. The picks are not "a folder whose only entry is a subfolder" (the picker turns that into the
# subfolder), because the parent also holds the two loose photos. Written by hand.
# Columns: source (a photo of the golden fixture, path under golden/, one of the rows of golden-photos.tsv), place (path under
# overlap/). `kit-fixtures.sh build overlap` copies each source to its place with its time kept and removes anything else under
# overlap/. The photo count of overlap in expected-counts.tsv is the number of rows below (eight).
